description: This is a PHP class 'SuiteBeanResource' that extends 'Resource', located in the 'SuiteCRM' project. It handles conversion between SugarBean objects and JSON API resource representations, including handling relationships, attributes, files, and datetime fields. The class includes methods for creating resource objects from SugarBeans, converting back to SugarBeans, and dealing with file uploads/downloads.

classes.name: SuiteBeanResource
classes.description: A resource class that facilitates conversion between SugarBean objects and JSON API resource representations, including handling attributes, relationships, file uploads/downloads, and datetime fields.

methods.name: fromSugarBean
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean instance into a SuiteBeanResource, including attributes and relationships, with support for datetime conversion and file retrieval.

methods.name: toSugarBean
methods.description: Converts the resource back into a SugarBean object, saving changes, handling relationships, and file uploads.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Creates a resource object from a JSON API request data array.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Adds a relationship to the resource object.
